user_reported_bug: The /admin/service-charges route was rendering the legacy Bill Payment Service Charges Configuration page instead of the new Phase-3 PRC Redemption Service Charges admin dashboard. Testing agent reported this in iteration_291.
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Verified code routing and ran focused UI flow: logged in as admin@test.com, opened /admin/service-charges, confirmed the Phase-3 dashboard rendered with all required data-testids and heading 'Redemption Service Charges' while legacy text was absent. Also verified /admin/bill-service-charges still renders the legacy Service Charges Configuration page. Relevant app APIs returned 200; only unrelated Google Ads 403 console noise was observed.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js now imports AdminServiceCharges from '@/pages/Admin/AdminServiceCharges' and maps /admin/service-charges to it; /admin/bill-service-charges maps to AdminBillServiceCharges. Runtime UI evidence matched this route split.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Focused bug verification only. Skill lookup for 'admin service charges route dashboard' returned no relevant testing skill. UI test used https://formula-audit-fix.preview.emergentagent.com, admin@test.com / 153759. Required dashboard testids all present: admin-svc-charges-page, stat-pending, stat-paid, stat-total, stat-rate, search-input, search-btn, days-filter, refresh-btn, charges-table, revenue-chart. Relevant endpoints observed as 200: /api/auth/check-auth-type, /api/auth/login, /api/admin/redemption-service-charge/{summary,pending,revenue-report,search}, and legacy /api/admin/service-charges.
rca_of_the_issue: Previous failure was caused by /admin/service-charges resolving to the legacy bill-payment AdminServiceCharges file. The fix separates imports/routes so the new Phase-3 PRC dashboard owns /admin/service-charges and the legacy config remains available at /admin/bill-service-charges. Reproduction no longer occurs.
